question.text: Within what period from the date of occurrence must an investor lodge a complaint on SCORES?

answer.text: Within 1 year from the date of occurrence
Within 6 months from the date of occurrence
Within 3 years from the date of occurrence

explanation.text: The Logic: Investors must first address their concerns to the Entity's designated officials. They may then lodge a complaint on SCORES within 1 year from the date of occurrence. The Trap: 3 years is the limitation period in many civil matters, but the SCORES window is 1 year. Note: The 1-year SCORES filing window is set by the framework cited in the Series VI workbook.
